checks.question: Do dependency manifests, lockfiles, containers, vendored code, or generated artifacts include known-vulnerable dependency versions (known-vulnerable dependency)? (BLD-001)

onYes.title: Fix vulnerable dependency (BLD-001): upgrade, patch, or isolate
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Known-vulnerable dependencies expose the app to published exploits.

Find all instances: Search manifests/lockfiles/containers/vendored code for versions flagged by the ecosystem's advisory/audit tooling.

Fix correctly: Upgrade to a patched version, apply a patch, replace the dependency, or isolate it if no fix exists. Re-run the audit.

Constraints: Check license of any replacement (BLD-016). Keep the build green; update lockfiles (BLD-010).

Acceptance: No known-vulnerable dependency remains (or it's documented/suppressed with rationale). Re-run dependency audit clean.

checks.question: Are there unpinned dependencies, floating version ranges, missing lockfiles, or network-dependent resolution making builds non-reproducible (non-reproducible dependency resolution)? (BLD-002)

onYes.title: Fix non-reproducible deps (BLD-002): pin versions and commit lockfiles
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Floating dependency versions make builds non-reproducible and can pull in breaking/malicious updates.

Find all instances: Search for unpinned/floating dependency ranges and missing lockfiles.

Fix correctly: Pin versions and commit lockfiles (or equivalent dependency-graph locks) so resolution is deterministic.

Constraints: Keep the build green. Combine with integrity verification (BLD-010).

Acceptance: Dependency resolution is deterministic. Add/commit lockfiles; add a CI check for unpinned deps.

checks.question: Are there dependencies in manifests not imported, referenced, or required at runtime/build/test (unused dependency)? (BLD-003)

onYes.title: Fix unused dependency (BLD-003): remove from manifest
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Unused dependencies enlarge the attack surface and artifact size.

Find all instances: Search manifests for dependencies with no import/reference/runtime use.

Fix correctly: Remove unused dependencies from the manifest and lockfile.

Constraints: Confirm no dynamic/reflective/plugin use before removing. Keep the build/tests passing.

Acceptance: No unused dependencies remain. Ensure build and tests pass after removal.

checks.question: Are there imports/usages of packages not declared as direct dependencies (direct reliance on transitive dependency)? (BLD-004)

onYes.title: Fix transitive dependency reliance (BLD-004): declare direct deps
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Relying on transitive deps breaks unexpectedly when an intermediate dep changes its own dependencies.

Find all instances: Search for imports of packages not declared as direct dependencies.

Fix correctly: Declare those packages as explicit direct dependencies with pinned versions.

Constraints: Keep versions consistent with the resolved graph. Update lockfiles.

Acceptance: Used packages are declared directly. Ensure build/tests pass; add a lint check if available.

checks.question: Are there manual edits in generated, vendored, compiled, or checked-in third-party code (manual edit to generated/vendor code)? (BLD-005)

onYes.title: Fix manual edits to generated/vendor code (BLD-005): move to source
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Manual edits to generated/vendored code are lost on regeneration/update and hide intent.

Find all instances: Search generated/vendored/third-party code for manual modifications.

Fix correctly: Move changes to the source generator/config, a managed patch process, a fork, or an upstream contribution; then regenerate/re-vendor.

Constraints: Don't hand-edit generated output. Keep regeneration deterministic (BLD-015).

Acceptance: Generated/vendored code matches its source with no manual edits. Add a drift check (BLD-014).

checks.question: Are compiled/minified/generated artifacts committed as source without a clear policy or need (build artifact committed as source without reason)? (BLD-006)

onYes.title: Fix committed build artifacts (BLD-006): remove or document policy
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Committed build artifacts cause drift, bloat, and confusion about the source of truth.

Find all instances: Search for committed compiled/minified/generated artifacts lacking a documented reason.

Fix correctly: Remove the artifacts and generate them in the build, or document and enforce a generated-asset policy where committing is intentional.

Constraints: Don't break consumers that depend on a committed artifact without providing the build step.

Acceptance: Committed artifacts are removed or policy-documented. Ensure the build produces them; update .gitignore.

checks.question: Do builds depend on current time, randomness, machine path, environment, network, or filesystem ordering (non-deterministic build input)? (BLD-007)

onYes.title: Fix non-deterministic build (BLD-007): remove nondeterminism
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Non-deterministic builds produce different artifacts from the same source, breaking reproducibility and caching.

Find all instances: Search build steps for dependence on time, randomness, machine paths, environment, network, or filesystem ordering.

Fix correctly: Remove nondeterminism (fixed timestamps/seeds, sorted ordering, relative paths) or make it explicit and reproducible.

Constraints: Combine with reproducible deps (BLD-002) and deterministic codegen (BLD-015).

Acceptance: Builds are reproducible. Add a check building twice and comparing outputs where feasible.

checks.question: Do build/test/release scripts pass branch names, filenames, env vars, or package metadata into shell commands unsafely (build script executes untrusted input)? (BLD-008)

onYes.title: Fix unsafe build script input (BLD-008): avoid shell expansion of untrusted input
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Interpolating untrusted values (branch names, PR titles) into build shell commands enables command injection in CI.

Find all instances: Search build/CI scripts for untrusted values (branch/tag/filename/env/metadata) interpolated into shell commands.

Fix correctly: Avoid shell expansion of untrusted input; pass values as arguments/environment to fixed commands, and validate/allowlist where they drive behavior.

Constraints: Prefer allowlists. Apply OS command-injection guidance (INJ-004).

Acceptance: Build scripts don't shell-expand untrusted input. Add a test/review with a malicious branch name proving it can't inject.

checks.question: Do CI workflows expose secrets to pull requests, forks, logs, artifacts, or untrusted scripts (CI secret exposed to fork/log)? (BLD-009)

onYes.title: Fix CI secret exposure (BLD-009): restrict and mask secrets
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Secrets available to fork PRs or printed to logs/artifacts get stolen.

Find all instances: Search CI configs for secrets available to fork/PR-triggered jobs, untrusted scripts, or echoed into logs/artifacts.

Fix correctly: Restrict secret availability to trusted (non-fork) jobs, mask outputs, and separate trusted/untrusted job stages.

Constraints: Rotate any exposed secret. Never log secrets (CSP-002).

Acceptance: Secrets aren't exposed to untrusted CI contexts. Review/adjust the workflow; confirm masking.

checks.question: Do package managers or artifact downloads operate without lockfiles, checksums, signatures, or integrity verification (missing lockfile/integrity verification)? (BLD-010)

onYes.title: Fix missing integrity verification (BLD-010): commit lockfiles and verify checksums
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Without integrity verification, dependencies/artifacts can be tampered with in transit or at the registry.

Find all instances: Search dependency installs and artifact downloads for missing lockfiles, checksums, or signature verification.

Fix correctly: Commit lockfiles with integrity hashes and verify checksums/signatures for downloaded artifacts.

Constraints: Combine with reproducible deps (BLD-002) and provenance (BLD-011).

Acceptance: Dependencies/artifacts are integrity-verified. Ensure lockfiles/checksums are present and enforced.

checks.question: Do release/deploy pipelines accept packages or containers without provenance or signing checks (package provenance not verified where required)? (BLD-011)

onYes.title: Fix unverified provenance (BLD-011): require signed/attested artifacts
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Deploying unsigned/unattested artifacts allows supply-chain substitution attacks.

Find all instances: Search release/deploy pipelines for acceptance of packages/containers without provenance/signature verification.

Fix correctly: Require signed or provenance-attested artifacts and verify before deploy.

Constraints: Combine with integrity verification (BLD-010).

Acceptance: Only verified artifacts deploy. Add a pipeline check rejecting unsigned/unattested artifacts.

checks.question: Are there mutable tags, reused version numbers, latest labels, or artifacts without immutable build identifiers (ambiguous artifact versioning)? (BLD-012)

onYes.title: Fix ambiguous versioning (BLD-012): use immutable identifiers
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Mutable tags/'latest' make it impossible to know exactly what's deployed and break rollbacks.

Find all instances: Search for mutable tags, reused versions, and 'latest' references in build/deploy.

Fix correctly: Use immutable semantic/build identifiers (pinned digests/versions) with traceable provenance.

Constraints: Keep references to specific digests/versions in deploy config.

Acceptance: Artifacts are referenced by immutable identifiers. Update references; add a check against mutable tags.

checks.question: Are there absolute local paths, developer home directories, machine-specific paths, or workspace assumptions in build config (environment-specific absolute build path)? (BLD-013)

onYes.title: Fix absolute build paths (BLD-013): use relative paths and variables
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Absolute/machine-specific paths break builds on other machines and CI.

Find all instances: Search build config/scripts for absolute local paths, home dirs, or machine-specific workspace assumptions.

Fix correctly: Use relative paths and build variables; resolve paths from the project root.

Constraints: Combine with platform path handling (RES-014).

Acceptance: Build config is path-portable. Ensure the build works from a clean checkout on another machine/CI.

checks.question: Do generated code, clients, docs, migrations, or assets differ from the source schema/spec (generated files stale versus schema/source)? (BLD-014)

onYes.title: Fix stale generated files (BLD-014): regenerate and enforce drift checks
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Stale generated artifacts drift from their source, causing subtle integration bugs.

Find all instances: Search generated code/clients/docs/migrations for divergence from the source schema/spec.

Fix correctly: Regenerate from source and add a CI drift check that fails when generated output is stale.

Constraints: Don't hand-edit generated output (BLD-005). Keep generation deterministic (BLD-015).

Acceptance: Generated files match source and a drift check exists. Regenerate; ensure CI catches future drift.

checks.question: Do generators produce unstable ordering, timestamps, random IDs, or environment-specific output (non-deterministic code generation)? (BLD-015)

onYes.title: Fix non-deterministic codegen (BLD-015): stabilize generator output
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Non-deterministic generators produce noisy diffs and defeat drift checks/reproducibility.

Find all instances: Search code generators for unstable ordering, embedded timestamps, random IDs, or environment-specific output.

Fix correctly: Stabilize ordering, fix timestamps/seeds, and normalize formatting so output is deterministic.

Constraints: Combine with deterministic build (BLD-007) and drift checks (BLD-014).

Acceptance: Generation is deterministic. Add a check generating twice and comparing output.

checks.question: Are there dependencies, vendored code, snippets, models, or assets with missing, incompatible, or unclear licenses (unknown/incompatible license)? (BLD-016)

onYes.title: Fix license issues (BLD-016): review and resolve incompatible licenses
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Incompatible/unknown licenses create legal risk (copyleft/commercial-tier/SSPL/BSL constraints).

Find all instances: Search dependencies/vendored code/snippets/models/assets for missing, incompatible, or unclear licenses. Flag commercial-tier, copyleft (GPL/AGPL), SSPL, BSL, or EOL packages.

Fix correctly: Review each license and replace, isolate, attribute, or get approval as required by project policy; prefer permissively licensed alternatives.

Constraints: Honor the project's license rules; flag problematic licenses before adoption rather than assuming.

Acceptance: All dependencies have known, compatible licenses (or documented approvals). Add a license check to CI where feasible.

checks.question: Are there build/test commands that pass only if another manual command ran earlier (build/test command order dependency)? (BLD-017)

onYes.title: Fix command order dependency (BLD-017): make commands self-sufficient
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Hidden ordering requirements between commands cause flaky/failed builds for anyone who doesn't know the magic sequence.

Find all instances: Search build/test commands that depend on a prior manual step (codegen, install, fixture setup) without declaring it.

Fix correctly: Make each command declare and create its own prerequisites (dependencies in the build graph), so it works from a clean state.

Constraints: Keep determinism (BLD-007).

Acceptance: Commands work from a clean checkout without manual pre-steps. Verify on a clean environment.

checks.question: Are there projects without pinned compiler, runtime, package manager, formatter, or build-tool versions (toolchain version undeclared)? (BLD-018)

onYes.title: Fix undeclared toolchain (BLD-018): pin and document tool versions
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Unpinned toolchains cause 'works on my machine' inconsistencies and build drift.

Find all instances: Search for missing pins of compiler/runtime/package-manager/formatter/build-tool versions.

Fix correctly: Pin and document toolchain versions (version files/config) so all environments match.

Constraints: Keep CI and local in sync.

Acceptance: Toolchain versions are pinned/documented. Add the pins and confirm CI uses them.

checks.question: Do production images, packages, bundles, or deploy artifacts contain test tools, dev servers, mocks, or build-only dependencies (dev/test dependency in production artifact)? (BLD-019)

onYes.title: Fix dev deps in production (BLD-019): exclude non-runtime dependencies
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Shipping dev/test tooling enlarges the attack surface and artifact size.

Find all instances: Search production artifacts/images for test tools, dev servers, mocks, or build-only dependencies.

Fix correctly: Exclude non-runtime dependencies from production artifacts (multi-stage builds, prod-only installs) and shrink the image.

Constraints: Keep runtime dependencies intact. Combine with least-privilege containers (BLD-020).

Acceptance: Production artifacts contain only runtime deps. Verify the built image excludes dev/test tooling.

checks.question: Do container configs run as root, privileged, with broad capabilities, a writable root filesystem, or unnecessary tools (container/image runs with excessive privilege)? (BLD-020)

onYes.title: Fix excessive container privilege (BLD-020): drop root and capabilities
onYes.prompt:
Problem: Over-privileged containers amplify the impact of any compromise.

Find all instances: Search container/image configs for running as root, privileged mode, broad capabilities, writable root FS, and unnecessary tools.

Fix correctly: Run as a non-root user, drop unneeded capabilities, use a read-only root filesystem, and remove unnecessary tools.

Constraints: Keep the app functional with least privilege. Combine with dev-dep removal (BLD-019).

Acceptance: Containers run least-privilege. Verify the image runs as non-root with restricted capabilities.
